title: Foo Bar Materialized View Access Patterns
description: Ingest user activity events into ClickHouse and create materialized views for two access patterns: a daily activity summary per user and a top-users-by-duration leaderboard.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must load event data, then create two materialized views that pre-aggregate it for common dashboard queries.

tasks.description: Load sample event data into a base table, then create two materialized views: daily_summary (per-user daily counts and total duration) and top_users (all-time duration leaderboard).

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse installed but not running. Sample event data in /data/samples/user_activity_sample.csv.
